storyCards.headline: Centuries: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Fall Out Boy's "Centuries" reached #10 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Centuries" is a song by American rock band Fall Out Boy, released September 9, 2014 as the lead single from their sixth studio album, American Beauty/American Psycho (2015).

The song peaked at #10 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 34 weeks on the chart.

Centuries was released in 2015.

Album: American Beauty / American Psycho (2015).

Chart story — peaked at #10 on the Hot 100.
